dsh-model-picker 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。dsh web 输入栏模型选择面板：左侧提供商栏 + 右侧模型列表，两侧独立滚动，支持跨提供商搜索。

posts.en:
dsh-model-picker is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Provider-tabbed model picker for the dsh web composer: left provider column and right model list, both independently scrollable, with cross-provider search.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a0ac3e0d73892719eebe.html
